name: Tomb of Nefertiti
review:
A 5x3 Egyptian game where every win gives a respin on the winning spots. Wilds on reels 2 to 5 never respin, so they hold their place for the whole sequence.

Wild Raider can drop up to nine wilds on the middle reels on any spin, and Curse of Nefertiti adds another random feature. Medium volatility, 3,768x max and a 96.19% RTP.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
